title: Oven-Roasted Spicy Brazilian Meat Paella
description: A spicy and flavorful Brazilian-inspired dish featuring tender meat and pillowy rice, suitable for meal prep and no onion, no garlic recipes.

ingredients.name: Cayenne pepper
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for desired spiciness

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Brazilian-style chorizo and cook for 1 minute, until lightly browned.
Add the rice to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
In a separate pot, combine the chicken broth, water, thyme, rosemary, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour the nimono-simmer broth over the rice and meat mixture.
Stir to combine, then cover the pot with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 25-30 minutes, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
